records.text:
return {
    adapterKey: adapter.adapterKey,
    status,
    successRate:
      status === 'healthy'
        ? 0.995
        : status === 'watch'
          ? 0.975
          : status === 'degraded'
            ? 0.92
            : 0.5,
    latencyMs:
      status === 'healthy'
        ? 35
        : status === 'watch'
          ? 75
          : status === 'degraded'
            ? 190
            : 900,
    lastCheckedAt: nowIso(),
    incidents:
      status === 'healthy'
        ? 0
        : status === 'watch'
          ? 1
          : status === 'degraded'
            ? 3
            : 7,
    notes: [
      `Derived from provider availability=${adapter.availability}.`,
    ],
  };
}
